# Brendon Mapinda — Creative Studio + Automation Lab

> Cape Town–based creative studio and automation lab run by Brendon Mapinda. Two disciplines under one operator: premium cinematic photography & video (the Studio), and AI automation, software development & business optimization (the Systems / Lab). Brand promise: premium visuals, smart systems, business growth — helping brands look premium and run smarter.

## What Brendon does

- **The Studio (visuals):** editorial portraits, brand & venue content (lounges, bars, products, personalities), cinematic short-form reels for Instagram/TikTok, and event coverage (graduations, baby showers, brand activations). Photographer/cinematographer since 2017, with eight years refining a single editorial aesthetic — Lightroom-finished, premium, moody and lifestyle-led.
- **The Systems / Lab (AI & software):** AI automation and AI agents, custom web app and software builds, business-process optimization, and AI discoverability (structuring products and content to be found and recommended inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and AI search). Background as an AI-augmented data & migration engineer; 5+ applications built and deployed.
- **The Growth Partnership:** a monthly retainer combining cinematic content with the systems that capture and convert it — the flagship bundle.

## Pricing (South African Rand, indicative)

- Studio sessions: Mini R850 · Signature R1,350 (most booked, includes a cinematic reel) · Premium Creative R2,000–R2,500.
- Event coverage: from R1,800 (Basic) to by-quote (Full).
- Systems: Automation Sprint from R7,500 · Custom Build from R25,000 · Systems Retainer from R4,500/month.
- All Systems figures are starting points; every build is scoped to the problem.
